Applied revision to the file with a surgical edit—here’s the new Decision section:

We will adopt a weekly asynchronous standup format for the Falcon team on a trial basis, to run for the next 4 weeks. All team members will:

1. Share written updates every Monday in a designated async channel (e.g., Slack thread or shared doc).
2. Keep updates concise, focusing on accomplishments, blockers, and planned work for the week.
3. Review others’ updates and comment/respond as needed by end of Monday.

This replaces synchronous daily meetings for the duration of the trial.
